pattern: Freeland was in Moscow during the 1990s post-Soviet asset stripping. She helped Browder — who used Mossad agents for security and Israeli billionaires for financing — build his public case. She then became the politician who pushed his Magnitsky sanctions agenda through Canadian law. Browder turned $25M into $180M from Russian privatizations while his security was manned mainly by Israelis.
